archetype: LUXURY & HIGH-CONTRAST CONCIERGE (The Obsidian & Champagne Gold Protocol)
theme: Dark Charcoal, Rich Obsidian & Champagne Gold Accents with Light Contrast Sub-Surfaces

typography.anti_default_rule: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for main brand/hero headings and Outfit for section headers/dashboard titles.

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-normal text-slate-100
hierarchy.card_h3: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-semibold tracking-wide text-amber-100
hierarchy.sub_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-400/90 font-mono font-medium

rules: Never use pure black #000000; use obsidian charcoal #0B0C0E.
Gold (#D4AF37 / #F3E5AB) is reserved for high-value CTA buttons, active states, key stats highlights, and delicate 1px borders.
Ensure high contrast meeting APCA standards for dark background readability.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_card: relative rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900/90 to-slate-950/90 p-6 border border-amber-500/20 hover:border-amber-400/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-xl
visual_enhancers.champagne_badge: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use 2x-3x standard spacing. Sections must use py-20 lg:py-32 and px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-12.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Card containers must have inner padding (p-6 to p-8) to avoid text-edge collisions.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

navigation_and_header.desktop_nav: Sticky or top-fixed header with backdrop blur (bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md), subtle gold bottom border (border-b border-amber-500/20), z-50.
navigation_and_header.links: Marketing pages must show direct visible desktop links for Solutions, How It Works, Live Demo, Pricing, FAQs, and Login/Get Started CTA.
navigation_and_header.dashboard_nav: Left sidebar on desktop with multi-tenant workspace switcher, active link indicators with champagne gold pill highlight, top header with notification bell, AI assistant status indicator, and quick action schedule button.

component_usage_rules.file_format: All frontend components are written in .js / .jsx (React JavaScript, not TypeScript .tsx).
component_usage_rules.interactive_components: Use Shadcn components (Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Calendar, Switch, Select, Table, Sheet, Sonner) with heavy Tailwind override for dark luxury gold theme.
component_usage_rules.forms: Never use plain raw select; use Shadcn Select/Dropdown. For date pickers, use Shadcn Calendar popover.
component_usage_rules.toasts: Use Sonner toast component located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx for booking confirmations, lead follow-up triggers, and settings updates.

motion_and_interactions.library: Framer Motion for smooth page transitions, stagger child reveals, floating AI concierge widgets, and modal entrances.
motion_and_interactions.interactive_states: All buttons must have active press, hover scaling (hover:scale-[1.02]), and focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400/50). Exclude 'transform' from universal transitions.
motion_and_interactions.micro_animations: Glowing pulse on live AI call reception status (e.g., 'AI Phone Reception: Active').

luxury_concierge_bell.description: Golden bell on luxury reception desk representing 24/7 AI reception.

executive_workspace.description: Executive working on laptop at modern luxury desk.

luxury_salon_spa.description: Modern high-end boutique lobby for local service businesses.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, links, modals, calendar dates, settings toggles) MUST have kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Marketing Homepage and Dashboard/Admin flows are fully integrated in React.
Incorporate simulated interactive AI Assistant widgets (AI phone receptionist simulator with voice wave playback & AI web chat widget preview).
Support multi-tenant business switching (e.g., 'Aura Luxury Spa', 'Vanguard Law Firm', 'Apex Dental Studio').
Provide clear tabs in the Business Owner Dashboard: Overview, AI Phone Receptionist, Chat Assistant, Lead Follow-ups, Appointment Calendar, Customers, Customization, Billing, and Admin Tools.
Follow dark charcoal & champagne gold styling relentlessly. Avoid default white canvas or saturated blue buttons.
Include sample data for bookings, leads with automated email/SMS sequence status, and AI phone transcripts.
